items.title: Absolute eosinophil count
items.description: Measures the total number of eosinophils in the blood.
items.usage: Used to detect allergic conditions and parasitic infections.

items.title: Bleeding time
items.description: Measures time required for bleeding to stop after a small skin puncture.
items.usage: Evaluates platelet function and vascular integrity.

items.title: Blood for microfilaria
items.description: Microscopic examination of a blood smear to detect microfilariae (filarial parasites).
items.usage: Used to detect microfilariae to diagnose lymphatic filariasis.

items.title: Blood for parasite-Malaria(slide)
items.description: Tests used to detect malaria parasites in the blood through microscopic examination or rapid antigen detection.
items.usage: Gold standard for detecting and identifying malaria parasite species and density.

items.title: Body fluid for Acid-Fast Bacilli (ZN stain)
items.description: Detection of acid-fast bacilli in body fluid using Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
items.usage: Used to diagnose extrapulmonary tuberculosis.

items.title: Bone marrow aspiration
items.description: Microscopic evaluation of bone marrow aspirate and/or biopsy to assess blood cell production, marrow cellularity, and detect hematological disorders.
items.usage: Assesses blood cell production and helps diagnose leukemias and other marrow disorders.

items.title: Bone marrow trephine biopsy
items.description: Microscopic evaluation of bone marrow aspirate and/or biopsy to assess blood cell production, marrow cellularity, and detect hematological disorders.
items.usage: Evaluates marrow architecture, cellularity, and detects focal lesions or fibrosis.

items.title: Bronchioalveolar lavage fluid for cytology
items.description: Microscopic examination of BAL fluid to detect inflammatory cells, infectious organisms, and malignant cells from the lower respiratory tract
items.usage: Used to evaluate lower respiratory tract diseases by identifying infections, inflammatory conditions, and detecting malignant cells

code.display: Cytopathology, review of bronchioalveolar lavage specimen (procedure)

items.title: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis ( cell count)
items.description: Helps evaluate infections, inflammation, and other neurological conditions by assessing biochemical and cellular components of cerebrospinal fluid.
items.usage: Evaluates infections (meningitis), inflammation, or hemorrhage in the CNS.

code.display: Cell count and differential, cerebrospinal fluid

items.title: Clotting time
items.description: Measures time taken for blood clot formation.
items.usage: Provides a crude assessment of the intrinsic and common coagulation pathways.

items.title: Coagulation Profile
items.description: Application of special stains on histology or cytology samples when clinically indicated.
items.usage: Used to highlight specific cellular components or organisms in tissue samples.

items.title: Coagulation Time
items.description: Time taken for blood to clot under standard conditions.
items.usage: Used as a basic screening for coagulation disorders.

items.title: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
items.description: Quantitative platelet count with microscopic assessment of platelet size and shape. Used in bleeding disorders and thrombocytopenia evaluation.
items.usage: Used in evaluation of thrombocytopenia, thrombocytosis and bleeding disorders.

items.title: Coombs test direct with titre
items.description: Detects antibodies or complement attached to the surface of red blood cells.
items.usage: Used to diagnose autoimmune hemolytic anemia and hemolytic disease of the newborn.

items.title: Coombs test indirect with titre
items.description: Detects free antibodies in the patient’s serum that may react with red blood cells.
items.usage: Used in pre-transfusion cross-matching and prenatal screening for Rh incompatibility.

items.title: Cytochemical stain of slides
items.description: Applies specific chemical stains on blood or marrow smears to identify cellular enzymes or constituents. Commonly used in leukemia classification.
items.usage: Crucial for the classification and differentiation of acute leukemias.

items.title: Dengue virus(Patho)
items.description: Detection of dengue virus antigen (NS1), nucleic acid, or antibodies (IgM/IgG) to diagnose dengue infection.
items.usage: Used in diagnosis of acute dengue infection.

code.display: Polymerase chain reaction test for Dengue virus

items.title: Differential leucocyte count (DLC)
items.description: Breaks down the different types of white blood cells present in the blood.
items.usage: Used to identify the type of infection or immune response.

code.display: Differential white cell count estimation procedure

items.title: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
items.description: Measures how quickly red blood cells settle in a tube, reflecting inflammation in the body.
items.usage: Used to diagnose malaria infection.

items.title: Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC) - Periodic acid-Schiff stain
items.description: Microscopic examination of FNAC specimen using Periodic acid–Schiff (PAS) stain to detect glycogen, mucin, and fungal elements.
items.usage: Used to identify glycogen-rich tumors, mucin-producing lesions, and fungal organisms, aiding in diagnosis and characterization of neoplastic and infectious conditions

items.title: Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC) – CT guided
items.description: Image-guided FNAC performed under CT guidance for deep-seated or non-palpable lesions.
items.usage: Used for sampling deep-seated abdominal or thoracic lesions with high precision.

code.display: Deep fine needle aspiration biopsy using computed tomography guidance (procedure)

items.title: Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC) – USG guided
items.description: Ultrasound-guided FNAC for precise sampling of lesions not easily accessible clinically.
items.usage: Used for precise sampling of non-palpable nodules or deep-seated lesions.

code.display: Ultrasonography guided fine needle aspiration biopsy of soft tissue

items.title: Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC)- Reticulin stain
items.description: Microscopic examination of FNAC specimen using reticulin stain to assess the reticular fiber framework.
items.usage: Used to evaluate tissue architecture and differentiate benign from malignant lesions, especially in tumors and bone marrow conditions

items.title: Fluid cytology - Sputum cytology
items.description: Microscopic cytological examination of sputum to identify malignant, premalignant, or inflammatory cells from the respiratory tract. Used in the evaluation of suspected lung malignancy and chronic respiratory diseases
items.usage: Used to screen for lung malignancy and chronic inflammatory respiratory diseases.

code.display: Microscopic cytologic examination of sputum specimen

items.title: Fluid cytology CSF including India lnk preparation
items.description: Cytological examination of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) including India ink preparation to assess cells and detect encapsulated organisms
items.usage: Used to diagnose central nervous system infections (especially cryptococcal meningitis), inflammation, and detect malignant cells

items.title: General blood picture
items.description: Microscopic examination of peripheral blood smear to assess red cells, white cells, and platelets. Used to identify morphological abnormalities.
items.usage: Assesses RBC, WBC, and platelet morphology to identify hematological abnormalities.

items.title: H&E staining (Histopathology examination)
items.description: Microscopic examination of tissue sections stained with Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) to assess cellular and tissue morphology for pathological diagnosis.
items.usage: Used for general tissue evaluation, diagnosis of inflammatory conditions, and identification of benign and malignant lesions

items.title: Hemoglobin- Finger Prick
items.description: Measures the concentration of hemoglobin in blood to assess anemia, polycythemia, and overall oxygen-carrying capacity.
items.usage: Rapidly assesses for anemia or blood loss, common in screening clinics.

items.title: Hemoglobin- venipuncture
items.description: Measures the concentration of hemoglobin in blood to assess anemia, polycythemia, and overall oxygen-carrying capacity.
items.usage: Provides a more precise assessment of anemia and oxygen-carrying capacity.

items.title: International Normalized Ratio (INR)
items.description: Standardized ratio of prothrombin time used to monitor blood coagulation.
items.usage: Provides a universal scale for monitoring anticoagulant (Warfarin) therapy.

items.title: Leucocyte Esterase
items.description: Detection of enzyme activity indicating presence of white blood cells and possible infection.
items.usage: Used in screening for urinary tract infection.

items.title: Lupus Erythematosus cell
items.description: Detects LE cells formed by phagocytosis of antibody-coated nuclear material. Historically used in systemic lupus erythematosus evaluation.
items.usage: Historically used for SLE evaluation (now largely replaced by ANA testing).

items.title: Microscopy for FNAC-Routine MGG
items.description: Microscopic evaluation using May-Grünwald Giemsa staining to assess cellular morphology in fine needle aspirates.
items.usage: Used to examine cell morphology in FNAC samples for detecting inflammation, infection, or malignant changes

items.title: Microscopy for special staining
items.description: Microscopic examination using special staining techniques to identify specific cellular or microbial components.
items.usage: Used to identify microorganisms, characterize tissue constituents, and support diagnosis of infections, metabolic, and neoplastic conditions

items.title: Nasal discharge for eosinophil
items.description: Microscopic examination of nasal smear to detect eosinophils. Useful in allergic rhinitis assessment.
items.usage: Useful in distinguishing allergic rhinitis from other forms of rhinitis.

items.title: Nitrite
items.description: Detection of nitrite indicating presence of nitrate-reducing bacteria and possible infection.
items.usage: Used in screening for urinary tract infection.

items.title: Packed Cell Volume (PCV)
items.description: The percent of blood made up of red blood cells.
items.usage: Used to assess anemia, dehydration, and polycythemia.

items.title: Pap smear
items.description: Microscopic examination of cervical and vaginal cells.
items.usage: Used to detect precancerous or cancerous lesions.

code.display: Microscopic examination of cervical Papanicolaou smear (procedure)

items.title: Pericardial fluid analysis
items.description: Laboratory examination of pericardial fluid to assess cellular, biochemical, and microbiological characteristics
items.usage: Used to diagnose pericardial effusions by identifying infection, inflammation, malignancy, or hemorrhage

items.title: Peritoneal fluid
items.description: Laboratory examination of peritoneal (ascitic) fluid to assess cellular, biochemical, and microbiological characteristics
items.usage: Used to diagnose ascites by identifying infection, inflammation, malignancy, or liver-related disorders

items.title: Platelet count
items.description: Measures the number of platelets in the blood, which help in clotting.
items.usage: Used to assess bleeding disorders and clotting abnormalities.

items.title: Platelet morphology
items.description: Microscopic evaluation of platelet size, shape, and distribution to assess platelet abnormalities
items.usage: Used in evaluation of infection, inflammation and hematological disorders.

items.title: Prothrombin Time (PT)
items.description: ime taken for blood to clot via the extrinsic pathway.
items.usage: Used to monitor Warfarin therapy and evaluate liver function or vitamin K deficiency.

items.title: Rapid malaria test for Plasmodium falciparum (PF)
items.description: Rapid antigen test to detect Plasmodium falciparum infection using immunochromatographic methods.
items.usage: Used for rapid identification of Plasmodium vivax infection.

items.title: Rapid malaria test for Plasmodium sp.
items.description: Tests used to detect malaria parasites in the blood through microscopic examination or rapid antigen detection.
items.usage: Used for rapid identification of Plasmodium falciparum infection.

items.title: Rapid malaria test for Plasmodium vivax (PV)
items.description: Rapid antigen test to detect Plasmodium vivax infection using immunochromatographic methods.
items.usage: Used to assess bleeding disorders and monitor anticoagulant therapy.

items.title: RBC indices panel
items.description: Calculated parameters of red blood cells including MCV, MCH, and MCHC derived from complete blood count
items.usage: Used to classify anemia and evaluate red cell morphology and hemoglobin content for diagnostic assessment

items.title: Red Blood Cell Count (RBC)
items.description: The number of red blood cells present in a given volume of blood.
items.usage: Used to evaluate anemia, polycythemia, and overall hydration status.

items.title: Reticulocyte count
items.description: Measures the number or percent of immature red blood cells (reticulocytes) in the bloodstream.
items.usage: Used to assess bone marrow activity and response to anemia treatment.

items.title: Rotavirus Molecular test for Acute Diarrhoeal disease
items.description: Detection of rotavirus nucleic acid to diagnose infection.
items.usage: Used in detection of Rotavirus infection in acute diarrhoeal disease

items.title: Semen analysis
items.description: Analysis of synovial fluid including volume, cell count, glucose, protein and LDH.
items.usage: Used in evaluation of arthritis, joint infections and inflammatory joint diseases.

items.title: Septic screening for neonates (as a defined test)
items.description: Panel of laboratory tests performed to evaluate suspected sepsis in neonates, typically including CBC, CRP, blood culture, and other infection markers
items.usage: Used for early detection, diagnosis, and monitoring of neonatal sepsis to guide timely treatment

items.title: Sickling Slide Test - Finger prick
items.description: A rapid screening test used to detect the presence of Haemoglobin S (HbS). Helps quickly identify individuals with sickle cell trait or sickle cell disease. Positive results require confirmation with Hb electrophoresis or HPLC.
items.usage: Quick screening to identify sickle cell trait or disease; requires confirmation by electrophoresis.

items.title: Sickling Slide Test - Venipuncture
items.description: Screens for the presence of sickle-shaped red blood cells caused by abnormal haemoglobin (HbS). Helps identify suspected sickle cell anaemia or sickle cell trait, and is often used as an initial screening test before confirmatory testing like Hb electrophoresis.
items.usage: Helps identify suspected sickle cell anemia or trait before confirmatory testing.

items.title: Special histopathology staining (microscopy)
items.description: Microscopic examination using specialized histopathological stains to evaluate tissue morphology and pathology.
items.usage: Used to identify microorganisms, demonstrate tissue elements (e.g., collagen, mucin, iron), and aid in diagnosis and classification of diseases, including infections and malignancies

items.title: Synovial fluid analysis
items.description: Laboratory examination of synovial (joint) fluid assessing physical, chemical, and microscopic characteristics
items.usage: Used to diagnose joint disorders by evaluating inflammation, infection, crystal-induced arthritis (e.g., gout), and degenerative conditions

items.title: Thoracentesis (for cytology of pleural fluid)
items.description: Aspiration of pleural fluid, which may then be sent for cytological examination
items.usage: Used to determine the cause of pleural effusion (e.g., malignancy or infection).

items.title: Total Lymphocyte count
items.description: Quantifies lymphocytes in peripheral blood. Used to assess immune status and hematological disorders.
items.usage: Used to assess immune status and monitor chronic infections or hematological disorders.

items.title: Total neutrophil count
items.description: Measures the number of neutrophils in the blood, helping assess immune response and detect infections or inflammatory conditions.
items.usage: Used in classification and evaluation of anemia.

code.display: Enumeration of neutrophils in peripheral blood

items.title: Total WBC count
items.description: Measurement of the ratio of immature to total neutrophils in blood to assess bone marrow response and detect infection, especially in neonates.
items.usage: Used to assess bacterial infection, inflammation and bone marrow function.

items.title: Urine culture for Acid-Fast Bacillus (AFB)
items.description: A urine test to detect acid-fast bacilli, used to help diagnose genitourinary tuberculosis caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
items.usage: Used specifically to diagnose genitourinary tuberculosis.

items.title: Urine for malignant cells.
items.description: Cytological examination of urine sediment to detect atypical or malignant cells shed from the urinary tract. Used in the evaluation and follow-up of urothelial malignancies.
items.usage: Used in the screening and follow-up of bladder and urothelial cancers.

code.display: Microscopic examination of urine for malignant cells

items.title: Urine Ketones
items.description: Detection of ketone bodies to evaluate metabolic status and fat metabolism.
items.usage: Used in evaluation of diabetic ketoacidosis, starvation and metabolic disorders.

code.display: Measurement of ketones in urine using dipstick (procedure)

items.title: Urine Routine examination
items.description: Comprehensive analysis of urine including physical, chemical, and microscopic examination
items.usage: Used to assess renal function and diagnose urinary tract infections, kidney diseases, and metabolic disorders

items.title: Urine Special test
items.description: Urine dipstick-based special tests detecting leukocyte esterase, bilirubin, urobilinogen, ketones, and nitrites
items.usage: Used to screen for urinary tract infection, liver dysfunction, hemolysis, and metabolic conditions such as ketosis

items.title: Urobilinogen
items.description: Measurement of urobilinogen level to assess liver function and hemolysis.
items.usage: Used in evaluation of hepatobiliary disease and hemolytic anemia.
